title: .gitignore semantics
prompt: Implement `static bool IsIgnored(string path, List<string> rules)` — rules like "bin/" (directory prefix), "*.log" (extension wildcard), or exact names; earlier rules win, and any rule starting with "!" un-ignores. Path matches "bin/" when the path starts with "bin/".

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: Prefix and extension rules applied in order.

tests.name: negation
tests.hint: The last matching rule decides — git's actual semantic.
